name: m6_my_voice_oui

spec.name: m6_my_voice_oui
spec.brief: The user's own voice as a filter. Morph 0 is their 'oo', Morph 1 their 'ee', so the morph says 'oui'. Q opens to their 'aa' under Morph 0 and closes to their 'nn' hum under Morph 1. Targets are cepstrally smoothed spectra of the recordings with +6 dB per octave to take the voice source's slope out. The two lowest lanes trade poles across Morph, as Talking Hedz does. Second pass: the ee, aa and oo recordings are whispered, so no slope correction is applied to them (+6 dB per octave only on the voiced hums); every target is held flat below 0.6 x its first peak, because the recording's roll-off down there is microphone and radiation, not the mouth, and a vocal tract is flat towards DC.
